Data-freshness note:
Date range to Category Location SKU type
Date range, category, location, and SKU-type filters apply across Tab 1, Tab 2, and Tab 3 (and the topline below). The topline's "Total Orders" denominator also narrows by Location (so WFR% for a single warehouse is meaningful), but not by Category or SKU type — those don't partition all orders placed, only the numerator. Tab 3's "Total orders processed" denominator stays pinned to the full 90-day window since a picker/checker's total throughput needs the full window to be meaningful, but "Error orders" (and the derived error-free count / error rate) recompute live from the filtered tickets, and the Location filter narrows which warehouse groups are shown. "T-2" (day before yesterday) replaces the old "Yesterday" quick-filter and Tab 4's pull window, per ops feedback that Warehouse-team comments often aren't posted yet by the time T-1 data is pulled. Tab 4 is always T-2, unaffected by these filters. SKU-type classification (cold-chain vs non-cold) is only available for orders placed in the last 90 days; a handful of very old or edge-case orders with no item-batch record show as "Unknown" and are excluded when a SKU-type filter is active.
